name: eBay (used marketplace, via GPUDojo offer tracker) price page for nvidia-rtx-pro-4500-blackwell
notes: Asking price, not a completed sale. GPUDojo card page (prices last updated 2026-10-19 02:17 UTC) lists 'Used from $4,350' on eBay for the RTX PRO 4500 32GB (10,496 CUDA cores, 896 GB/s, 200W); the page marks it 'near 90-day low'. eBay itself is blocked from this IP, so the figure and the listing link come from GPUDojo's tracked offer rather than a page I loaded on ebay.com - hence medium. eBay price excludes shipping and tax.
